retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered ensemble composition featuring a central group of characters against a desert horizon, framed by heavy black borders and bold condensed yellow typography.
triggerTerms: soundtrack cover layout with black borders

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant group portrait of diverse characters standing in a desert environment, characterized by a high-contrast color split between a bright blue sky and red-orange earth, framed by a thick black border containing secondary information and bold, blocky yellow display text.
coreVisualRelationships: Central character group anchored by a man in white shorts
Horizontal horizon line bisecting the image into blue and orange halves
Heavy black framing at top and bottom containing white and yellow text
Large-scale yellow title block positioned in the lower third
coreInvariants: High-contrast saturation between sky and ground
Black letterboxing at the top and bottom of the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large group of ten people occupies the center, arranged in a loose V-formation with the central figure slightly forward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central man in a white shirt and shorts, flanked by the large yellow title block below.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central figure, move upward to the blue sky text, then down through the group to the large yellow title, finally scanning the credits in the black footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal within the central image; significant negative space provided by the black borders at the top and bottom.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue (sky) and earthy red-orange (ground) creating a complementary contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black borders providing a neutral frame for the vibrant central image.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow used for the primary title and key header text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central photograph with high-value white and yellow text for maximum legibility against dark backgrounds.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' with a closed loop and short descender

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a thin yellow outline box

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform use of condensed sans-serifs across different weights and colors to maintain a cohesive, high-impact look.
graphicDevices: Thin yellow rectangular frame around the main title
Small yellow bus icon near the group

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and blocky feel of the main title.
Provides the necessary verticality and clean sans-serif structure.
Captures the tight spacing and heavy weight of the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a diverse group of ten people in casual 90s clothing standing in a desert landscape with a clear blue sky and red-orange sand. Add thick black borders at the top and bottom of the image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large two-line title in extra-condensed yellow sans-serif in the lower third, enclosed in a thin yellow box. Add white condensed sans-serif text in the top blue sky area and small white credits in the bottom black border.

verificationChecks: Is the main title yellow and extra-condensed?
Are there black borders at the top and bottom?
Is the horizon line clearly visible between the sky and sand?
Is the text in the sky white with a subtle shadow?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
Thickness of the yellow title frame
Font weight of the secondary credits

avoid: Modern minimalist sans-serifs like Helvetica Light

postGenerationChecks: Check that the yellow title is centered and boxed.
Ensure the black borders do not obscure the main subjects.
Verify the sky text is legible against the blue background.
Confirm the ensemble group feels like a cohesive unit.
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble Group + Desert Horizon + Black Letterbox + Condensed Yellow Display Type
